candidates.statement: Inventory's Redis reserve_inventory calls time out (~2s), causing inventory 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; whether timeout stems from Redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating inventory 503 -> order ReadTimeout -> gateway 502, matching inventory metrics (reserve_inventory 503s, 2425ms p95) and topology inventory->redis. Order postgres ops show no errors.
